purpose_context: On 2026-11-23 obsidian-sync (Restart=always) restarted 39 times in about 7 minutes after a Node 22 to 24 switch and nothing alerted, because existing monitoring only checks for failed units. This mission closes that blind spot so a restart loop reaches Kent within minutes (kentonium3/kg-automation#1133).
purpose_tldr: Alert when a systemd unit on office2 keeps restarting, even though it never reaches the failed state.
